# Airborne C4 13.5

**Prototype:** Airborne C4 · **years:** 2008 · **group:** [Topless](/wings/topless/) · **topless**

![Model of the Airborne C4 13.5 in the game (Blender render)](/docs/models/screenshots/glider_air_c4/iso45.jpg)

## Data

Numbers are as in the game (`configs/wings/air_c4.json`). Marks: **passport**, **analog**, **estimate** — [what they mean](/wings/#provenance-marks).

| Parameter | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Span | 10 m | **passport**: [card DHV 01-0428-08](https://service.dhv.de/db1/technicsearchpage.php?lang=DE) “10.0 m” |
| Area | 13.5 m² | **passport**: [card DHV 01-0428-08](https://service.dhv.de/db1/technicsearchpage.php?lang=DE) “13.5 m2” |
| Wing mass | 35 kg | **passport**: [card DHV 01-0428-08](https://service.dhv.de/db1/technicsearchpage.php?lang=DE) “35.0 Kg *)” |
| Pilot mass with hang point | 69–109 kg | **estimate**: DHV “Startgewicht” 104–144 kg minus wing mass 35 kg ([card DHV 01-0428-08](https://service.dhv.de/db1/technicsearchpage.php?lang=DE); no hook-in figure in the passport) |
| Double surface | 93 % of span | **passport**: [card DHV 01-0428-08](https://service.dhv.de/db1/technicsearchpage.php?lang=DE) “93.0 %” |
| Kingpost | no (topless) | **passport**: quote from the manufacturer's page: [airborne.com.au](https://www.airborne.com.au/pages/hg_c4.php) |
| Class / certification | DHV 3 (DHV 01-0428-08) | **passport**: [card DHV 01-0428-08](https://service.dhv.de/db1/technicsearchpage.php?lang=DE) |
| Years of production | 2008 | **estimate**: sample of manufacturer pages / certification year (3D model spec, section N33) |
| Trim speed | 36.4 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Combat GT 13.2 scaled by wing loading (f = 0.9848) |
| Speed, control frame fully pulled in | 98.5 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Combat GT 13.2 scaled by wing loading (f = 0.9848) |
| Stall (straight flight) | 27.6 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Combat GT 13.2 scaled by wing loading (f = 0.9848) |
| Minimum sink | 0.827 m/s at 40.4 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Combat GT 13.2 scaled by wing loading (f = 0.9848) |
| Glide ratio | 16 at 49.2 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Combat GT 13.2 scaled by wing loading (f = 0.9848); scaling does not change the glide ratio — same as the base |
| Wind at launch | topless, 20–25 m/s | **estimate**: class by crossbar, class limit per the pilot (configs/wing_classes.json); a game menu hint, not used in the physics |
| Reference pilot mass (for the polar) | 87 kg | **estimate**: game model: same place in the range as the base Aeros Combat GT 13.2 |
